title: Costume 솔로 #120 · USSBBW · 경찰관 · 의자 앉기 · 레드카펫 계단 · 홍콩풍
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous warm-ivory complexion, mid 50s goddess, USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; an immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant; a gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other; every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass, the sheer weight of the flesh visible in how it spills forward and settles, her body so wide that her hips nearly touch the left and right edges of the frame; real photographic skin with visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, sleek slicked-back lavender hair — wearing a micro police costume of a minimal black leather bustier of two small opaque molded cups with a silver badge on one strap, a black leather micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, a wide belt with silver handcuffs at her hip and a black peaked police cap, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare. Pose: seated on a wide wooden chair with a tall backrest, her legs stretched out in front of her — most extreme USSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each a full hand-length past her fingertips, in glossy black leather with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Chinese woman (East Asian Chinese features: a longer oval face with prominent high cheekbones and a defined jawline, long upturned phoenix-shaped eyes with sharp inner folds, a high strong nose bridge, thin arched eyebrows with a slight rise, balanced lips), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: thin sharply arched brows, soft brown and rose eyeshadow, a fine black liner with a small flick, long curled lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a strong rose-red blush on the apples of the cheeks, deep glossy red lips with a defined edge.

Background: a wide red-carpeted grand staircase with standard-height steps, a waist-high brass handrail and warm daylight from tall windows, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
